effectivePrompt: Edit the attached ORIGINAL photograph into a faithful black-line portrait on pure white. Preserve this woman, her exact facial proportions, expression, head angle, full hairstyle and framing. EYES ARE THE PRIORITY: preserve the original gaze and the visible iris size, placement and eyelid contours in BOTH eyes. Draw each visible iris as a clearly defined thin circular or elliptical contour, with a small dark pupil inside and a tiny white highlight. Keep the sclera white and clearly separate it from the iris, upper lid and eyelashes. Render the dark source irises using contours and restrained inner detail rather than filling the whole eye black. Do not leave empty eye sockets or blank irises. Do not merge pupils, eyelashes, eyebrows and eyelids into black blobs. Do not enlarge the eyes or change their direction. Only draw parts visible in the source; preserve natural eyelid occlusion. Eye details must remain readable even when other details are simplified. Use sparse flowing contours elsewhere, but retain complete visible iris contours and small dark pupils in both eyes. Simplify clothing before eyes. No broad fills.

settings.prompt: Create an elegant minimalist contour portrait from the main reference. Select only the most informative contours that communicate likeness: eyes, eyebrows, nose profile, lips, jaw and major hair shapes. Use sparse long flowing black lines on white. Omit minor wrinkles, pores, fabric texture and background. Keep both eyes legible when visible. Avoid decorative extra strokes. Do not force the entire drawing into one continuous line.
